lines.t: My promises stand and My Holy Covenant endures forever.
Therefore, when one comes to Me in the name of The Son, in sincerity and in truth, they are forgiven, even forever and ever. Amen.
For I said, “Let there be a Lamb without spot or blemish, sacrificed for the atonement of sin,” and so it was,
“And let The Lamb be The Son of God, The Holy One of Israel, in whom all the nations of the earth shall be blessed,” and so it is, forever and ever!
Let My people cry out, “God is with us!”
Let My people cry out, “God is with us!”
